purpose: One connected chat HUD concept; user rejects detached controls and unclear boundaries. Concept only, do not alter WBP.
image_provider: native image_gen tool; exact image model not exposed

attempts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished concept image of a redesigned ProjectM fantasy MMORPG CHAT HUD. This is a single proposed design, not a contact sheet, not an asset atlas, not a technical diagram. Landscape 16:9, at least 1600px wide.
INPUT IMAGE is the old chat concept: use its cool blue palette, ivory typography and restrained champagne fantasy identity as stylistic reference. REDESIGN its structural joints thoroughly according to the requirements below.

Composition: a close-up game screenshot-like presentation. One compact, elegant chat assembly anchored lower-left, taking about 70% of canvas width and 55% height. Show the complete chat with generous visible safe margins, never crop it. Behind it, softly blurred sunlit HD-2D fantasy village with greenery, cobblestone, stylized timber houses and distant blue rooftops. Background is atmospheric and subordinate. No banner, brand, title, caption, arrows, explanatory labels, other HUD, other panels or characters.

MOST IMPORTANT design requirement: the channel tabs, transcript and bottom input are physically JOINED into one beautifully resolved silhouette. ZERO background-visible gap between header/body/footer or adjacent tabs. Header extends the body wall, bottom input is INSIDE the same outer boundary. All share exact left/right edges. No detached pill buttons, no floating framed rectangles perched above the log, no separate input box floating below. Make a continuous engineered connection, not simply moving separate panels closer.

Shape:
- One understated continuous outer frame, clean ivory satin metal with restrained warm champagne highlights. Border is visibly strong and readable, roughly 3px at a 1000px-wide panel, plus a narrow blue shadow beside it to maintain contrast over scenery. NOT a faint hairline. Uniform thickness and crisp joint geometry.
- Small, tasteful chamfered outer corners, short accent engraving only near upper-left and lower-right; modern stylized fantasy, not medieval filigree.
- Top edge has a gentle stepped silhouette for the active first tab. Active tab has no closed lower outline: it joins directly into the transcript surface. A short gold accent stroke with a small diamond indicates selection. Idle tabs have quiet narrow vertical separators, NOT complete independent surrounding frames.
- The entire top row stays contiguous and reaches the right outer wall. Four adjacent tabs with restrained ivory icons and labels: speech bubble “일반”, location pin “지역”, globe “월드”, people “파티”. Selected “일반” is soft brighter blue. At the right, “‹”, “›”, “+” share a single integrated header section divided by short vertical rules. All are visibly clickable without standalone boxes.
- Message body is a lightly translucent medium blue navy around #34546E/#2D4B65 with softly frosted world detail. It must look BLUE, not gray, black or muddy green. Header and footer are one modest step deeper blue. No glossy plastic, bright neon, heavy bevel or high-frequency texture. Body has generous consistent horizontal padding and 6 neatly spaced text rows, well-scaled modern Korean sans-serif.
- A slim ivory scrollbar sits inside the right wall.
- Bottom input is an integrated full-width footer connected directly to the body by ONE clean pale divider. Left section shows pin icon, “지역”, small down chevron; one vertical separator; remaining width contains pale-blue hint “메시지를 입력하세요”, and a small subtle “Enter” keycap at far right. Do NOT add paper plane or send button. The input strip must be clearly separate by hierarchy but part of the same housing; no nested individual perimeter frames.

Message text exactly:
“[지역] 리베르: 마을 입구에서 만나요.”
“[일반] 미나: 새 퀘스트 확인했어요?”
“[파티] 루카: 준비되면 출발할게요.”
“[월드] 아리아: 함께 모험할 분을 찾습니다.”
“[일반] 미나: 좋아요, 곧 도착해요.”
“[시스템] 새로운 모험 기록이 추가되었습니다.”
Ivory body text, soft sky-blue channel labels/names, final system row muted warm gold. Clear Korean, balanced line heights.

Visual quality target: sophisticated modern mobile fantasy HUD, quiet blue satin, purposeful limited warm metal accents, precise visible structural boundaries and beautiful overall proportions. The assembly should still read clearly when scaled down to around 600px wide. More beautiful through silhouette, disciplined rhythm and coherent joints, not extra ornament. No gray UI, parchment/book, gigantic crest, huge gold frame, generic web messenger bubbles, detached components, broken border, uneven lines, duplicate message blocks, labels outside the UI, watermark or logos.

qa: Visually reviewed generated image: connected header/body/footer without scene gaps, readable continuous outer frame and internal rules, stepped active tab and small diamond, coherent blue/ivory/champagne. Korean messages readable; one full concept, safe margins. Subtle input inset and extra hint wording accepted as illustrative; not a runtime asset.
